items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Eddie Jones, Bas’, Sonny Payne and Freddie Green.

ctx.x: What was the basic rhythm section while you were in the group?
Eddie Jones, Bas’, Sonny Payne and Freddie Green.
Freddie was certainly an important part of that.
